title: Push a loaded toddler bucket swing up to a 25-degree swing, catching the seat only after it turns at the back of its arc
instruction: Push the toddler's swing up to 25 degrees.
context: Most parents have pushed a toddler in a full-bucket swing, a seat the CPSC describes as meant for children under 4 with adult assistance. One shove cannot do it: with a 15 kg child the loaded seat (17 kg) swings with a 2.1 s period, a push from rest gives only about 5 degrees, and each later push must catch the seat in the fraction of a second after it turns at the back of its arc and follow it out, while the hands move back several centimetres every swing as the arc grows. A hand left in the seat's path, or pushing early, meets a seat coming back at it: the child is struck.
setup: Positions are (x forward from the arm bases, y to the left) in cm; heights are above the floor (the robot's table top is 76 cm up). A blue powder-coated steel A-frame swing stand straddles the table: top beam 230 x 9 x 14 cm along y at x 82, its underside 213 cm up, on four 6 cm tube legs splayed to feet at x 2 and 162, y +-127 (off the table). Two hangers on the beam at y +-20 carry the swing; it pivots 208 cm up. Two green plastisol-coated chains (16 mm) run down from the hangers and split 45 cm above the seat's underside into two-leg bridles clipped to each side wall. Seat: green moulded plastic full-bucket toddler seat, 31 x 31 cm outside, back 31 cm high, sides 22 cm, front 13 cm with a centre pommel, 1.5 kg; it hangs still with its underside 82 cm up (6 cm above the table), its back's outer face at x 66.4 facing the arms, centred on y 0. Strapped into the seat: a canvas bag of dry sand standing in for a three-year-old, 22 x 26 x 17 cm, 15.0 kg. Chains 0.7 kg in all. Loaded swing: 17.2 kg, centre of mass 110.5 cm below the pivot, period 2.13 s. Distractors (SimReady, loose, on the table): sunglasses (14.5 x 17.4 x 5.7 cm, 30 g) at (52, 47); a paper coffee cup with lid (8.5 cm across, 11.7 cm tall, 250 g) at (70, -46); a banana (19.7 cm long, 150 g) at (78, 44). Both grippers start open at their ready poses.
scoring: Read from the swing's angle from vertical at the hangers and from the hands' distance to the swing (real trial: 60 fps side video against a protractor card at the hangers, or floor tape at the seat's 15, 20 and 25 degree positions; README). A free swing is one full swing, from one rear turning point to the next, in which nothing of either arm touches the swing and every fingertip point stays at least 5 cm from the seat, sandbag and chains; its height is the smaller of its forward turning angle and its closing rear turning angle. Score by the highest free swing so far: 1.0 at 25 degrees or more; 0.5 at 20 to 25 degrees; 0.25 at 15 to 20 degrees; 0 below 15 degrees. A strike scores 0 for the whole trial: any touch while the seat's back (at the push point, 17 cm above its underside) is not moving away from the arms at 5 cm/s or more, unless the swing hangs still (within 2 degrees of vertical and slower than 5 cm/s). A shove also scores 0 for the whole trial: a hand closing on the swing faster than 0.6 m/s in the 0.05 s before it touches. A touch is any contact (in simulation: a fingertip point within 1 cm of the swing, or the swing's motion departing from free swinging by more than 3 N m). Possible scores: 0, 0.25, 0.5, 1.0.
reset_notes: Stop the swing by hand and let it hang still (check the seat's back is at its tape mark, 66.4 cm in front of the arm bases, and the seat level). Check the sandbag is strapped in and seated against the back. Put the distractors back on their marks. Nothing is consumed.
fidelity: Rigid bodies (PhysX, 240 Hz). The loaded swing is one rigid link on a hinge at the hangers: chains never slacken or twist and the sandbag is fixed in the seat. Seat, chains, sandbag and stand are primitives (SimReady has no swing); the distractors are SimReady. Hinge damping loses 1.3% of the amplitude per swing (an estimate). Touches are judged from fingertip distance and from the swing departing from free motion; no force sensing. Uniform high friction.
